sources.supports: Four product views show the three-well and two-well faces, cylindrical body, shallow long ledges and four cord bores (two per end). Exterior return spans are visible. Existing seven contact IDs remain authoritative; photographs do not establish new training contacts. A graph of two bores plus exterior return at each end differs from a hidden U channel.
